settings.title: Clear My AI conversation data
settings.description: Snapchat retains all content shared with My AI until explicitly deleted. Clear My AI Data removes your 1:1 chat history. Deletion from servers takes up to 30 days. Does not affect group chats with My AI.

settings.title: Restrict location sharing with My AI
settings.description: My AI can access your location if you have granted location permission to Snapchat, enabling personalized place recommendations. Location sharing is off by default for all Snapchatters, but if enabled for Snap Map, My AI also gains access. Revoke Snapchat location permission at the OS level to prevent My AI from using location data.

settings.title: Enable two-factor authentication
settings.description: Supports SMS or authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Duo, etc.). OFF by default. Requires both a mobile number and an email address on the account. If using an authenticator app, back up recovery codes before factory resets.

settings.title: Disable activity-based ad targeting
settings.description: Snap shows ads based on your activity on third-party websites and apps that share data with Snap. ON by default. Disabling means you still see ads but they are less relevant.

settings.title: Disable audience-based ad targeting
settings.description: Snap uses audience lists received from advertisers and partners to target ads. ON by default. Disabling prevents matching against external audience lists.

settings.title: Disable third-party ad networks
settings.description: Snap shares limited data (IP address, Mobile Ad ID) with third-party ad networks to serve ads. ON by default. Disable to prevent external ad networks from receiving your data for ad targeting.

settings.title: Enable Ghost Mode on Snap Map
settings.description: Hides your real-time location from all other Snapchatters on Snap Map. Location sharing is OFF by default (Ghost Mode effectively on at first use). If you have previously enabled location sharing, re-enable Ghost Mode. Duration options: 3 hours, 24 hours, or until turned off. Note: Snap Map submissions and Snaps submitted to the Map are still visible regardless of Ghost Mode.

settings.title: Restrict Snap Map location sharing audience
settings.description: If location sharing is enabled, control who can see your location. Options: My Friends (all friends), My Friends Except... (exclude specific friends), Only These Friends (whitelist). Avoid sharing with all friends; use 'Only These Friends' for minimum exposure. Background ('Always') location sharing continuously updates your position even when the app is closed.
